message.withdrawalNotice: You are receiving this because you agreed to hear from Friends of Animals, for yourself or about your child. To stop these messages, open this link: {url}

meta.title: Campaigns
meta.description: Write a message once and send it to the people who agreed to hear from Friends of Animals.

admin.title: Campaigns
admin.lead: Write a message once, choose who it is for, and send it. Only people who agreed to hear from us receive it, and every message lets them stop.

denied.title: Only community managers send campaigns
denied.body: Ask a super admin for the community manager role if you need to reach the community.

notFound.title: We could not find that campaign
notFound.body: It may have been typed wrongly. Go back to the list to find it.

index.sentOn: Sent {date} to {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} other {# people}}

form.newLead: Save a draft, then preview it and see how many people it reaches before you send it.
form.subject: Subject
form.subjectHint: One line, up to 150 characters. It is the email's subject.
form.bodyHint: Plain text, up to 5,000 characters. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
form.segmentLead: Leave everything empty to send to everyone who agreed to hear from us. A person must match every part you fill in, and any one choice within it.
form.roles: People with any of these roles
form.rolesHint: Leave all unticked for any role, or none.
form.competitions: People taking part in any of these competitions
form.competitionsHint: Registered themselves, through their child, or through an institution they look after.
form.cities: People in any of these cities
form.citiesHint: Separate cities with commas, for example: Pune, Mumbai. From their own profile, their child's, or their institution.

errors.subject: Write a subject on one line, up to 150 characters.
errors.body: Write a message of up to 5,000 characters.
errors.segment: Check who it is for: up to 50 cities of up to 80 characters each.
errors.forbidden: Only community managers can do this.
errors.campaign_not_editable: This campaign has been sent, so it can no longer be changed.
errors.campaign_draft_changed: Someone saved this draft since you opened it. Reload the page and try again.

form.milestonesHint: Leave all unticked for any engagement journey. Earned milestones remain in history even after leaving.

detail.title: Campaign
detail.created: The draft is saved. Preview it below before sending.
detail.sent: The campaign is on its way.
detail.everyone: Everyone who agreed to hear from us

preview.title: Preview
preview.lead: This is how the message reads. Each person sees their own name and their own link to stop these messages.
preview.reach: It reaches {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} other {# people}}.
preview.matched: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody matches} one {# person matches} other {# people match}} who it is for.
preview.noConsent: {count, plural, =0 {Everyone matching agreed to hear from us.} one {# of them has not agreed to hear from us and is left out.} other {# of them have not agreed to hear from us and are left out.}}
preview.noGuardian: {count, plural, one {# child is} other {# children are}} left out because the guardian who agreed no longer looks after them.
preview.guardians: A message about a child goes to their guardian, never to the child.

progress.title: Sending
progress.planned: When it was sent, it reached {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} other {# people}}.
progress.sent: {count, plural, =0 {No messages have gone yet.} one {# message has gone.} other {# messages have gone.}}
progress.skipped: {count, plural, =0 {None was held back.} one {# was held back because consent was withdrawn first.} other {# were held back because consent was withdrawn first.}}
progress.queued: {count, plural, =0 {None is waiting.} one {# is waiting.} other {# are waiting.}}

send.title: Send campaign?
send.confirm: Send this campaign to {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} other {# people}}?
send.lead: It goes out at once, by email and in the app. You cannot change it or send it again afterwards.

refusals.forbidden: Only community managers can send campaigns.
refusals.campaign_already_sent: This campaign has already been sent.
refusals.campaign_draft_changed: The draft changed since you opened it. Check the preview and send again.
refusals.segment_empty: Nobody who agreed to hear from us matches who it is for, so there is nobody to send to.
refusals.unconfirmed: Confirm the send in the dialog to send the campaign.

open.lead: Friends of Animals sent you news because you agreed to hear from us.
open.own: Stopping withdraws your consent to news and updates from Friends of Animals.
open.children: Stopping withdraws your consent to messages about {count, plural, one {your child} other {your # children}}.
open.after: You will still receive messages we must send, such as sign-in codes and receipts. You can agree again at any time from your account.

done.title: You will not get these messages again
done.body: Your consent is withdrawn. You can agree again at any time from your account's consent page.

notFound.title: This link does not work
notFound.body: Check that you opened the whole link from the email. You can also manage what we send you from your account's consent page.
